title: The loop tests are split by area into tests_devloop/test_<area>.py files sharing loop_harness.py
objective: tests_devloop/test_devloop.py is replaced by 17 area files that share tests_devloop/loop_harness.py and hold the same test classes, unchanged, with the same test names.
outline: Do not read test_devloop.py in full (19k+ lines): this ticket carries what you need. Read lines 1-170 (imports, HERE/HOME/LOOP, git, GitIsolatedCase, LoopCase), own_origin (about old line 4883), and the T83/T82 loops (about old lines 13105 and 14771) if you want to see them. Write a throwaway script (scratch dir, not committed) that parses test_devloop.py with ast, cuts it into top-level statements (each with the comment and blank lines above it), and writes loop_harness.py and the 17 files from the list in old order with the fixed header, then `git rm tests_devloop/test_devloop.py`. Then edit board/config.json (4 map rows), devloop/README.md (the `## Tests` paragraph, about line 440), memory/project.md (line 5) and the T54 message. Write checks A-D as a second throwaway script; run them, the per-module import loop, `python3 -m unittest test_pool_git` (in tests_devloop), `python3 -m unittest test_adapter_unittest.Select` (in tests/) and the base set; paste their output in the hand-in. Strip every DEVLOOP_* variable from the environment before running tests (project memory). Facts measured on main f50b578: 168 top-level classes, 954 test ids; besides git() (line 36) the only module-level non-class statements after the header are own_origin (used by T37, T46, T47, T57, BoardAddressedUnits -> two files -> harness), ACTIONS78 (T78 only), T83_MISSING (T83 only), the two _name loops and the mid-file __main__ block; T54Acceptance is the only class that calls globals(); nothing in the file patches a target by the string 'test_devloop'; no moved line matches a hard_block pattern (os.kill, killpg, pkill, `kill -`) - if #100-#106 added one, the ticket stops for the user before merge whatever you do.
test_plan: No verifier: the change moves test code and edits config and docs, no product code, so no case can be red before it. The implementer runs checks A-D, the import loop of item 9, test_pool_git, test_adapter_unittest.Select and the base set once, and pastes their output in the hand-in. Red-before evidence by hand (unmeasured - run each once on the result, then undo from a saved copy, not git checkout): (m1) leave one class out of its file -> A lists its ids as removed and C lists its lines; (m2) change one character inside a moved class -> D names that class; (m3) add `from test_issuer import RoundsAndFeedback` to another test file -> B(a) names it, and A shows RoundsAndFeedback's ids twice. Every other file running alone and green, and the time, are the regression's `full` (item 12). Do not add a permanent test for the split: checks A-D are one-time hand-in checks.
notes: Known and kept (do not fix here): test_devloop.py defines class LiveRecordUnits twice - #64's at old line 6793 (subclass of StopRecordsCost, 7 own tests) and #65's at old line 17092 (2 tests). request:
# Split tests_devloop/test_devloop.py into files by area

The user asked for it (2026-11-21). tests_devloop/test_devloop.py is 19,446 lines with 168 classes, and every ticket adds its acceptance class to it: tickets of one group conflict at the same spots, and every agent that opens the file pays to read it. The new verifier and creator memory lines (memory/role/verifier.md, memory/role/creator.md) say cases go in the feature's own file or a new one; this makes that possible for agent-control itself.

Order: this work depends on every ticket now open (#100-#106) and must start only after they have landed, and verify alone (its own group): it moves code those tickets are adding to.

Wanted:
- Shared helpers (LoopCase, GitIsolatedCase, the fake agent plumbing, LOOP/HOME paths, git helpers and any other module-level helper several classes use) move to one helper module in tests_devloop/ that the test files import; no test file imports another test file, and no class inherits from a class in another test file (inheriting an acceptance class re-runs its cases).
- The classes move, unchanged in body, into files grouped by the area they test (for example issuer, controller and groups, regression and fixer, release, pool and tickets, board, memory, agents and quota, config and docs). Pick the areas from what the classes test; aim for files of a few thousand lines at most. Acceptance classes (T<id>Acceptance) go with their area.
- Nothing is lost: the total number of test methods and their names are the same before and after (prove it with a listing diff of class.method names before and after, ignoring the module part), every file runs alone (python3 -m unittest <module>) and the whole suite runs green, in about the same time as before.
- Everything that names the old module is updated in the same change: board/config.json tests map (the ids for devloop/* etc. become the new modules), base tests if any, documentation (devloop/README.md, project memory's test-id line, prompts or templates that mention test_devloop) and any test that reads test file names. Test ids stay module ids relative to the unittest roots.
- Out of scope: changing what any test asserts, speeding tests up, renaming classes.
